title: Fourier coefficient of the Maiorana–McFarland function
statement: Let $g$ assign a sign to each point of the $n$-dimensional binary cube, and let $a,b$ be points of the cube. The vector Fourier coefficient of the Maiorana–McFarland function at the concatenation of $a$ and $b$ is $2^{-n}$ times the real value of $g(a)$ multiplied by the Walsh character indexed by $b$ evaluated at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ maps the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the sign group
$a,b$ are points of the $n$-dimensional binary cube
